## Overview **Split PR of M3.1 (#63232; the model itself landed in main as #64111):** the engine part of its ROCm work, dual batch overlap under pure TP, split out to be reviewed and merged on its own. Dual batch overlap for pure tensor parallelism (one DP rank, no EP) on Model Runner V2: each microbatch's TP all-reduces run on the comm stream while the other microbatch computes. Related: #44677 (same goal on Model Runner V1, see Details), #63373 (removes Model Runner V1). ## Claims - `--enable-dbo` with `--tensor-parallel-size N` (N > 1) and no DP / EP works on MRV2 (`VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER=1`). Steps above `--dbo-prefill-token-threshold` split into two microbatches, and each TP all-reduce becomes a microbatch hand-off on the comm stream. - Multimodal models are allowed in this mode; the vision encoder runs outside the split. (Speculative decoding under DBO comes from main since #61464, in every mode.) - ROCm: the comm stream runs at high priority, and a hipBLASLt handle warm-up fixes a GPU hang of DBO steps (root cause below). - MRV1 rejects this mode with an explicit error. ## Validation - `pytest tests/v1/worker/test_dbo_pure_tp.py tests/v1/worker/test_gpu_dp_utils.py tests/v1/worker/test_gpu_ubatch_slicing.py tests/v1/worker/test_workspace.py tests/v1/worker/test_ubatch_offsets.py tests/test_config.py::test_dbo_thresholds_cover_a_request_per_microbatch`: 85 passed after merging main at `36ed4327d2` (MI355X, a ROCm image with this tree on `PYTHONPATH`). - `pre-commit run --files `: all hooks pass. - E2E on MI355X, TP4, M3 with MXFP4 experts, agentic multi-turn trace, 3600 s, one run per point. Measured on our M3 serving branch, which carries this change (`--dbo-prefill-token-threshold 8192 --dbo-decode-token-threshold 32768`): | concurrency | DBO | interactivity P90 (tok/s/user) | TTFT P90 (s) | total tok/s/GPU | |---|---|---|---|---| | 32 | off | 75.4 | 1.33 | 44573 | | 32 | on | 73.7 | 1.11 | 44009 | | 64 | off | 23.6 | 5.23 | 53692 | | 64 | on | 30.8 (+31%) | 3.21 | 59281 (+10%) | - E2E on this branch (merged with main at `36ed4327d2`) with a public model, DBO on: MiniMax-M3.1-Flash (`amd/MiniMax-M3.1-Flash-Quark-MXFP4`), TP4 MI355X, built into the InferenceX image `vllm/vllm-openai-rocm:minimax-m31-flash` (`sha256:ae868121`), served with the InferenceX AgentX recipe's c16 / c32 lane (NVFP4 KV, `--dbo-prefill-token-threshold 16384 --dbo-decode-token-threshold 32768`, max-num-seqs 2 x concurrency), DSpark 3 and 7 at InferenceX's synthetic acceptance lengths (2.88 / 4.04), the first 20 minutes of the AgentX trace, one run per point. Every server logs DBO on, the per-microbatch TP communicators and the comm-stream all-reduce hook; no request failed with a server error (1-2 per point came back without content):
  • Serving TTFT, M3.1-Flash TP4, the command below + --max-num-batched-tokens 32768, V2 runner, single request, median of 3:
    • prompt | base | DBO -- | -- | -- 16K | 468 ms | 304 ms (-35%) 32K | 952 ms | 582 ms (-39%) 64K | 1930 ms | 1545 ms (-20%) 8 concurrent 16K prompts | 35.0K tok/s | 56.4K (+61%) ## Details - **Split decision.** With one DP rank, `dispatch_cg_and_sync_dp` decides locally; a split step runs eager (`CUDAGraphMode.NONE`). Decode steps keep their CUDA graphs when `--dbo-decode-token-threshold` is above the decode batch. - **All-reduce hand-off.** `init_dbo_tp_comms` builds one `PyNcclCommunicator` per microbatch and installs a hook in `GroupCoordinator._all_reduce_out_place`. That function runs under the `vllm.all_reduce` custom op, so compiled graphs reach the hook. Inside a microbatch thread the hook yields to the other microbatch, runs the all-reduce on the comm stream over that microbatch's communicator, and switches back; elsewhere it returns `None` and the normal path runs. One communicator per microbatch keeps the two microbatches' collectives off one NCCL queue. - **Fused all-reduce + norm.** `fused_allreduce_gemma_rms_norm` skips its FlashInfer / AITER fused kernels inside a microbatch, so every all-reduce is a hand-off. Unsplit steps keep the fusion. - **MoE.** `MoEPrepareAndFinalizeNoDPEPModular.supports_dbo()` returns `True`: there is no all2all, the hand-offs are the TP all-reduces. - **Microbatch outputs.** `merge_ubatch_outputs` (tuples and lists since #61464) also passes `None` through, which DSpark's auxiliary outputs need. - **Workspaces.** Both microbatches compute on one stream, so the workspace manager keeps one set (`num_ubatches=1`). - **ROCm comm stream priority.** At the default priority, comm and compute can share one hardware queue and serialize. - **hipBLASLt hang (ROCm).** `hipblasLtCreate` allocates the Stream-K flag buffer and clears it with a `hipMemset` on the null stream. The call returns at once; the clear ran 3-33 ms later behind other work. torch keeps one Lt handle per (thread, stream), and the microbatch threads are new every step, so a step can create handles. When a Stream-K GEMM on the comm stream starts before the late clear, the clear zeroes flags that partner workgroups already set, and the owners spin forever in `label_SK_Fixup` (found with rocgdb). The fix fills the handle pool at `UBatchRunner` init: each microbatch thread runs one small GEMM on the compute, capture and comm streams. - **vs #44677.** #44677 adds the yield in `tensor_model_parallel_all_reduce` and opens the DP=1 path in Model Runner V1 (`gpu_model_runner`, `gpu_ubatch_wrapper`), which #63373 removes. This PR targets MRV2's `UBatchRunner`, hooks below the custom op, uses one communicator per microbatch, and adds the ROCm pieces. - **Limitations.** Split steps run without CUDA graphs. ---

(Mandatory for agents, optional for humans). - [x] AI assistance was used during the creation of this PR. - [x] **Design Fit:** Minimizes impact on core components, reuses existing functionality, and justifies added complexity. - [ ] **Testing and Validation:** Validates the change and ensures any added tests are meaningful and reliable, with CI coverage or documented CI resource constraints and validation performed outside CI. - [x] **Code Quality and Style:** Keeps code and comments clear and concise, and updates relevant documentation and examples. - [x] **Pull Request Contents:** Includes a brief summary and relevant links, supports claims with evidence, explains root causes and implementation trade-offs, and follows the contributing guide.

         self.ready_barrier = threading.Barrier(self.num_ubatches + 1)
+        init_dbo_tp_comms(self.parallel_config)

+        # TODO: remove once hipblasLtCreate no longer issues a null-stream memset.
+        if current_platform.is_rocm():
+            self._warm_blas_lt_handles()
+
+    def _warm_blas_lt_handles(self) -> None:
+        """Fill torch's hipBLASLt handle pool for the microbatch threads.
+
+        hipblasLtCreate clears a new handle's Stream-K flags with a null-stream
+        hipMemset that can land after a GEMM on the comm stream has started, and
+        the GEMM then never finishes. Microbatch threads are new every step and
+        take their per-stream handles from the pool."""
+        a = torch.zeros((64, 64), dtype=torch.bfloat16, device=self.device)
+        streams = (current_stream(), self.capture_stream, self.comm_stream)
+
+        def touch() -> None:
+            torch.accelerator.set_device_index(self.device.index)
+            for stream in streams:
+                with torch.cuda.stream(stream):
+                    torch.mm(a, a, out_dtype=torch.float32)
+
+        threads = [threading.Thread(target=touch) for _ in range(self.num_ubatches)]
+        for t in threads:
+            t.start()
+        for t in threads:
+            t.join()
+        torch.accelerator.synchronize(self.device)

LGTM. This fixes `--enable-dbo` for MiniMax-M3.1-Flash on Model Runner V2.

On main 2173d7121 startup fails with `Model Runner V2 does not yet support: dual batch overlap with multimodal models`. With this PR the server logs DBO on and the comm-stream all-reduce hook.

- 5 local 3600 s PD runs and two 3600 s 1P2D CI runs: all completed, no hang.

Not re-run on 7abcbbb6f1 (hipBLASLt warm-up moved to the ROCm platform).

Hope this can be merged soon :)

files.patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,180 @@
+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""DBO under pure tensor parallelism (one DP rank, no EP), without GPUs."""
+
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+from unittest.mock import Mock
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+import vllm.distributed.parallel_state as parallel_state
+import vllm.v1.worker.ubatching as ubatching
+import vllm.v1.worker.workspace as workspace
+from vllm.config import CUDAGraphMode, ParallelConfig, VllmConfig
+from vllm.sequence import IntermediateTensors
+from vllm.v1.worker.gpu.dp_utils import dispatch_cg_and_sync_dp
+from vllm.v1.worker.gpu.ubatch_utils import merge_ubatch_outputs
+
+
+def test_merge_tensors_concatenates_along_tokens():
+    a, b = torch.arange(6.0).view(3, 2), torch.arange(6.0, 10.0).view(2, 2)
+    assert torch.equal(merge_ubatch_outputs([a, b]), torch.cat([a, b]))
+
+
+def test_merge_recurses_into_tuples_and_lists():
+    # EAGLE3 returns (hidden, aux); DSpark returns (hidden, [aux, ...]).
+    h = [torch.full((2, 4), float(i)) for i in range(2)]
+    aux = [
+        [torch.full((2, 3), 10.0 + i), torch.full((2, 5), 20.0 + i)] for i in range(2)
+    ]
+    merged = merge_ubatch_outputs([(h[0], aux[0]), (h[1], aux[1])])
+    assert isinstance(merged, tuple) and isinstance(merged[1], list)
+    assert torch.equal(merged[0], torch.cat(h))
+    assert torch.equal(merged[1][0], torch.cat([aux[0][0], aux[1][0]]))
+    assert torch.equal(merged[1][1], torch.cat([aux[0][1], aux[1][1]]))
+
+
+def test_merge_keeps_none_and_intermediate_tensors():
+    assert merge_ubatch_outputs([None, None]) is None
+    parts = [
+        IntermediateTensors({"hidden_states": torch.ones(2, 4) * i}) for i in range(2)
+    ]
+    merged = merge_ubatch_outputs(parts)
+    assert merged["hidden_states"].shape == (4, 4)
+
+
+def _parallel_config(tp=4, dp=1, ep=False, dbo=True):
+    # An explicit backend skips the GPU count check: CI may run this on one GPU.
+    return ParallelConfig(
+        tensor_parallel_size=tp,
+        data_parallel_size=dp,
+        enable_expert_parallel=ep,
+        enable_dbo=dbo,
+        distributed_executor_backend="mp",
+    )
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    ("tp", "dp", "ep", "tp_only"),
+    [
+        (4, 1, False, True),
+        (4, 2, False, False),
+        (4, 1, True, False),
+        (1, 1, False, False),
+    ],
+)
+def test_dbo_tp_only(tp, dp, ep, tp_only):
+    assert _parallel_config(tp, dp, ep).dbo_tp_only is tp_only
+    assert not _parallel_config(tp, dbo=False).dbo_tp_only
+
+
+def _config(tp=4, dp=1, ep=False, spec=False, mm=False, enc_dec=False):
+    return SimpleNamespace(
+        model_config=SimpleNamespace(
+            is_multimodal_model=mm, is_encoder_decoder=enc_dec, is_hybrid=False
+        ),
+        parallel_config=_parallel_config(tp, dp, ep),
+        lora_config=None,
+        speculative_config=object() if spec else None,
+        compilation_config=SimpleNamespace(cudagraph_mode=CUDAGraphMode.FULL),
+        is_mm_encoder_only=False,
+    )
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    ("kwargs", "rejected"),
+    [
+        # pure TP: the vision encoder runs outside the split
+        (dict(mm=True), None),
+        (dict(spec=True, mm=True), None),
+        # anything that is not pure TP keeps the old restrictions
+        (dict(mm=True, dp=2), "multimodal"),
+        (dict(mm=True, ep=True), "multimodal"),
+        (dict(mm=True, tp=1), "multimodal"),
+        # encoder-decoder models stay out under pure TP too
+        (dict(enc_dec=True), "multimodal"),
+    ],
+)
+def test_dbo_unsupported_features(monkeypatch, kwargs, rejected):
+    monkeypatch.setenv("VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER", "1")

+# DBO under pure TP: each TP all-reduce is a hand-off point and runs on the comm

+def init_dbo_tp_comms(parallel_config) -> None:
+    """Build the per-microbatch communicators of the TP group (DBO under pure TP
+    only). Collective: every rank calls it in the same order."""
+    if not parallel_config.dbo_tp_only:
+        return
+    tp = parallel_state.get_tp_group()
+    if tp.ubatch_comms is not None:
+        return
+    from vllm.distributed.device_communicators.pynccl import PyNcclCommunicator
+
+    comms = [
+        PyNcclCommunicator(group=tp.cpu_group, device=tp.device)
+        for _ in range(parallel_config.num_ubatches)
+    ]
+    if any(c.disabled for c in comms):
+        logger.warning(
+            "DBO: the NCCL library is unavailable, the TP all-reduces of a "
+            "microbatch stay on the compute stream (no overlap)"
+        )
+        return
+    tp.ubatch_comms = comms
+    logger.info(
+        "DBO: %d per-microbatch TP communicators for the comm-stream all-reduce",
+        len(comms),
+    )

+def dbo_all_reduce(group, input_: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor | None:
+    """All-reduce of a microbatch on the comm stream, with the microbatch's own
+    communicator of ``group``. None outside a microbatch."""
+    ctx_idx = _THREAD_ID_TO_CONTEXT.get(threading.get_ident())
+    if ctx_idx is None:
+        return None
+    ctx = _CURRENT_CONTEXTS[ctx_idx]
+    logger.info_once("DBO: TP all-reduces of a microbatch go to the comm stream")
+    # No record_stream: the stream waits already order the buffers, and it would
+    # pin every block until the GPU catches up (out of memory at a 32k step).
+    out = torch.empty_like(input_)
+    ctx.yield_and_switch_from_compute_to_comm()
+    group.ubatch_comms[ctx_idx].all_reduce(
+        input_, out_tensor=out, stream=ctx.comm_stream
+    )
+    ctx.switch_to_compute_sync()
+    return out

+
+        def touch() -> None:
+            torch.accelerator.set_device_index(self.device.index)
+            for stream in streams:
+                with torch.cuda.stream(stream):
+                    torch.mm(a, a, out_dtype=torch.float32)
+
+        threads = [threading.Thread(target=touch) for _ in range(self.num_ubatches)]
+        for t in threads:
+            t.start()
+        for t in threads:
+            t.join()
+        torch.accelerator.synchronize(self.device)
